title: Challenge: green project but impossible QA window

repair.explanation: With code freeze on 2026-09-25, QA cannot complete before 2026-10-02. Moving the launch deadline to 2026-10-03 allows QA to finish on 2026-10-02 before launch.
Moving vendor migration completion two days earlier allows the launch to occur by 2026-10-10 while still satisfying the requirement that launch occur only after migration completes.
Extending the release deadline by one day allows the scheduled security review to complete on 2026-10-16, satisfying the requirement that security approval be complete on or before the release date.
Moving feature complete two days earlier allows integration testing to complete by 2026-11-22 and regression completion by 2026-11-26, meeting the launch deadline.

title: Earliest marketing launch conflicts with executive deadline

repair.explanation: Campaign assets cannot be ready before 2026-12-12, and the launch must occur after assets are ready. Moving the executive deadline to 2026-12-12 removes the conflict with the earliest feasible launch date.
Moving the production launch deadline to 2026-09-19 allows production launch to occur after the fixed 2026-09-18 cutover rehearsal, with the smallest practical two-day adjustment.
Moving the launch deadline to 2026-10-25 allows 3 days for reconciliation after migration completes on 2026-10-20, followed by 2 days for business validation.
